minimumGrossNative.label: Minimum eligible buy
minimumGrossNative.help: Gross native amount measured by the authenticated engine, before native platform and Creator fees.

endsAt.label: Rewards end at
endsAt.help: Must be strictly after the block timestamp when the instance is constructed.

refundWallet.label: Unused budget wallet
refundWallet.help: Required nonzero wallet. Fixed for the instance; only this wallet can reclaim unused funds at or after the end time.
